status.lmUnavailableBodyHosted: Check your API key and network connection for {{provider}}.

voice.setupNeeded: Voice input needs a local speech model.

history.title: Conversations
history.clearAllConfirm: Delete all conversations and their attachments? This cannot be undone.

backup.title: Backup
backup.intro: Save all settings to an encrypted file that only Local Assistant can open, and load them again here or on another computer. Conversations and MCP servers are not included.
backup.includeKeysHint: Off by default. The file is encrypted, but anyone who has it and this app can load the keys.

general.preloadModels: Load models when the app starts
general.preloadModelsHint: Speech recognition, voices, SILMA and the LM Studio chat model load in the background, so the first answer is instant. Uses memory while idle. Switch off single models in the list below; a model you unload loads again when it is needed.
general.windowPositionHint: Bottom-right, bottom-left and center lock the chat window in place. Choose Custom to drag it anywhere; it remembers where you leave it.
general.developerModeHint: Show MCP server, tool name, arguments, results and timing for every tool call.
general.startWithOsHint: Launch the assistant automatically when you sign in.
general.suggestionsHint: Shown as clickable suggestions on the empty chat screen. Leave a field blank to remove it.

ai.serverHint: Default: http://localhost:1234/v1. Works with any OpenAI-compatible server URL.
ai.serverHostedHint: Preset for this provider. Only change it to use a proxy or a regional endpoint.
ai.hostedNotice: Your messages are sent to {{provider}}'s servers, not kept on this computer.
ai.apiKeyHostedHint: Create an API key in your {{provider}} account and paste it here. It is stored only on this computer.
ai.noModelsHosted: No models returned. Check the API key, then press Refresh models.
ai.freeOnlyHint: Hides models that charge for use. Prices come from the provider.
ai.apiKeyHint: Only needed for a remote or third-party OpenAI-compatible server. LM Studio itself doesn't require one.
ai.noModels: No models found in LM Studio.
ai.contextHint: Leave empty to use the model's loaded context.
ai.systemPromptHint: Added to the built-in system prompt.
ai.showStats: Show speed and context per reply
ai.pasteAsFileHint: Pasted text longer than this many characters is attached as a text file instead of filling the message box. Leave empty to turn this off.
ai.shortNameHint: Shown in the chat instead of the full model name.

speech.micOnlyHint: Ignore system audio and loopback devices such as Stereo Mix. Turn off to allow them.
speech.isolateSystemAudioHint: While the speakers are audibly playing something, the microphone is ignored so it can't pick up PC audio. Also mutes your own voice if you talk over it.
speech.autoSubmitHint: Off: dictated text is added to the composer so you can review it before sending.
speech.foldersHint: Models installed by the app live in its own folder. Add your own folders to use models you downloaded yourself (Whisper, Parakeet/NeMo, SenseVoice, Moonshine, Paraformer).
speech.unsupportedHint: These folders contain models in a format the local speech engine cannot run.
speech.callViewHint: Show a phone-call style screen while a voice conversation is running.
speech.autoStopHint: Ends a recording when nobody speaks for this long (0 = never).

voice.speakAfterReplyHint: Waits until the answer is fully written, then speaks it. Speech starts later, but the voice and the chat model no longer compete for the GPU, so both run faster.
voice.genderHint: Used when a voice is chosen automatically.
voice.localHint: Voices can also be loaded from your own folders (see Speech Recognition - Model folders).
voice.unsupportedLanguageHint: Automatic detection and replies aren't available for this language yet — only its voice preference is used here.

language.responseAuto: Automatic — respond in the language you use
language.detectHint: English, Arabic and German are detected automatically from typed and spoken messages.
language.arabicTashkeelEnabledHint: Off: Arabic replies are written without diacritics (the default). On: replies include full تشكيل.
language.arabicTashkeelInstructionHint: Replaces the default tashkeel instruction sent to the model. Leave blank to use the default.
language.arabicTashkeelPlaceholder: Fully diacritize every word with complete تشكيل, applying إعراب rules precisely.

dictation.intro: Dictate text into any application, such as Notepad or your browser. Speech is recognized locally.
dictation.toggle: Press to start, press again to stop
dictation.correctionHint: Uses a small LM Studio model you choose. If it is unavailable, the raw transcript is inserted.
dictation.trailingSpace: Add a space after inserted text
dictation.languageHint: Also changeable from the dictation window. Automatic detects the language from your speech.
dictation.reviewHint: Show the result in the overlay so you can edit it, then insert it with Ctrl+Enter.
dictation.historyEnabledHint: Stored only on this computer (last 100). Useful when an insert fails or you closed the wrong window.
dictation.requiresStt: Dictation needs a local speech recognition model.
dictation.overlayPositionHint: Drag the dictation overlay freely — hold Shift to move it horizontally only, Alt to move it vertically only.

models.consent: Models are downloaded from Hugging Face and GitHub only when you click Download. They run fully offline afterwards.
models.customHint: You can also copy compatible sherpa-onnx models into the models folder.

gpu.title: GPU acceleration
gpu.intro: Speech recognition and text-to-speech can run on an NVIDIA GPU instead of the CPU. The CUDA libraries are a separate download, so the app itself stays small.
gpu.removeConfirm: Delete the GPU pack ({{size}})? Speech stays on the CPU, and the pack has to be downloaded again to use the GPU.
gpu.enableHint: Applies the next time the app starts.
gpu.restart: Restart the app to run the speech models on the GPU.
gpu.noNvidia: No NVIDIA GPU was detected, so the speech models stay on the CPU.

search.intro: Lets the assistant look things up on the web. SearXNG and DuckDuckGo work independently: turn on either one or both.
search.searxngHint: Your own SearXNG instance or a public one from searx.space. Collects results from many engines.
search.builtinHint: Searches DuckDuckGo. Works with no setup, but may be blocked for a while after many searches.
search.primaryHint: The other engine is used only when this one fails.
search.allOff: Both engines are off, so the assistant cannot search the web.
search.autoHint: Automatic: tries the most reliable instances in turn.
search.pickHint: Instances listed by searx.space that currently pass its test searches, most reliable first.
search.listError: Could not load the searx.space list.
search.notListed: Saved choice, not in the current list
search.testHint: Runs one real search with the settings above.

mcp.intro: MCP servers give the local model extra tools. Web search has its own page. Servers are never installed or enabled automatically.
mcp.importTitle: Import MCP servers from LM Studio
mcp.importHint: Imported servers are added disabled. Environment values (for example API keys) are copied into local settings.
mcp.importNone: No LM Studio MCP configuration was found.
mcp.name: Name
mcp.noTools: Connect the server to see its tools.
mcp.trustWarning: Only enable servers you trust. MCP servers run with your user permissions.
mcp.sensitiveHint: Safe mode is on: tools that change data or run commands always require confirmation.
mcp.safeModeHint: Tools that change data, run commands or are not recognized always ask before running. Turning it off needs your Windows PIN, fingerprint or face, and it turns back on every time the app starts.

privacy.title: Where your data goes
privacy.llmNetworkHint: Messages travel over your network to this address. Make sure it is a machine you trust.
privacy.llmCloudHint: Your messages and attachments are sent to {{name}} to generate replies, under their privacy terms. Pick LM Studio to keep chats on this computer.
privacy.internetViaHint: These tools can send the assistant's requests to online services.
privacy.webSearchHint: Search words the assistant picks are sent to these engines. Your conversation itself is not.
privacy.internetNone: No web search or internet tools are on
privacy.logContentHint: Off by default. Only enable temporarily for troubleshooting.

appearance.assistantNameHint: Shown in the window and used when the assistant introduces itself.

shortcuts.hint: Press a key combination with at least one modifier (Ctrl, Alt, Shift).
shortcuts.errors: Some shortcuts could not be registered:

diagnostics.noGpu: No dedicated GPU detected (CPU-only operation is supported)
diagnostics.acceleration: Voice models run on the CPU.
diagnostics.selfTestHint: Calls every backend command this window uses and reports which ones answer.

silma.title: Natural Arabic voice (SILMA)
silma.intro: SILMA speaks Arabic far more naturally than the built-in voices and adds the missing vowel marks (tashkeel) by itself. It speaks Arabic only; English and German use the built-in voices. It runs on PyTorch, so it is a one-time setup; after that the app starts and stops it automatically.
silma.hardwareHint: Force SILMA off the GPU even when GPU acceleration is on. Takes effect on the next sentence spoken.
silma.idle: Installed · starts when Arabic is spoken
silma.installConfirmGpu: This downloads about {{size}}: a private Python with PyTorch for your NVIDIA GPU, and the SILMA model. It takes a while and nothing else needs to be installed.
silma.installConfirmCpu: This downloads about {{size}}: a private Python with PyTorch and the SILMA model. Without an NVIDIA GPU, SILMA runs on the CPU and is noticeably slower.
silma.removeConfirm: Delete SILMA and its Python environment ({{size}})? Arabic goes back to the built-in voices.

memory.intro: Which models are loaded right now. Loaded models answer instantly but use RAM or GPU memory while idle.

setup.intro: A private assistant that runs on your computer with LM Studio.
setup.lmStudioHint: Start LM Studio and enable its local server (Developer → Start server), then press Retry.
setup.voiceIntro: Downloading the recommended local voice models for this computer so you can talk right away:
setup.shortcutHint: Press {{shortcut}} anytime to open the assistant.

overlay.hintToggle: Press the shortcut again to insert • Esc cancels
overlay.insertNowHint: Stop listening and insert what you said
overlay.retryHint: Throw this away and dictate again
